correctness.rationale: The exact energy derivative and crossing formula lead to uniform displacement 2M1/R²+2M3/R⁴+O(R^-5) and differentiable normalized remainder. Computations give M1=5lambda/2 and M3(0)=51/25. Strict derivative positivity of G(u,lambda) for 0<u<u0 proves one exterior fixed point for negative lambda and none for nonnegative; the fixed-point expansion supplies sharp radius and Poincare derivative 1-204/(25R^5)+o(R^-5). A standard-library diagnostic passed 13 assertions; it is not an infinite proof.
